name: tv-remote
description: Control y casting de televisores en la red local. Self-hosted, sin nube.

scripts.discover: npm run build:shared && npm run discover -w server --
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p web
